method: Eight exogenous combinations enumerated exactly with fractions; four joint p(reward,next_state|state,action) distributions independently evaluated; Bellman finite-horizon all 31 horizons (2 states, 2 actions), no original source imports/resets/steps.
proof: The one-step upper bound E[r|s,a]<=41/50 applies to any history-conditioned policy. A policy choosing a=s achieves that bound at every reachable state and time; therefore finite-horizon V_h(0)=V_h(1)=h*41/50 by induction, including h=31. Independent full joint-kernel Bellman DP exactly confirms the same for all horizons.
negative_exogenous_drift: Changing u1 to Bernoulli(1/2) changes match-state mean reward to 1/2 and invalidates original 41/50 expected reward; no hard-coded pass on changed source.
decision: Original pinned native CausalGym MDP can test genuine action observations and reward retention, but CANNOT distinguish added long-horizon planning value over fully informed exact one-step state-match control. Do not spend held source first-use expecting a planning advantage. Seek a different independently owned environment with delayed controllable consequences and nontrivial long-horizon optimal policy.
